name: R-330Zh Zhitel

placement_rationale.text: As a large, high-value truck-mounted jammer, Zhitel sits back from the direct-fire line to reduce its own exposure as a priority target once triangulated, per its own text, while staying forward enough to cover the ~30km drone-dense corridor doctrine.md §2 identifies as the zone that matters most. At 15km it sits well inside its own ~20-25km ground jamming range and inside that corridor, consistent with doctrine.md §4's framing of EW as a standoff capability rather than a forward, exposed one.

cost.display: Not publicly disclosed — described in reporting as one of the more sophisticated, expensive pieces of Russian EW equipment fielded

key_facts.label: Targets
key_facts.value: GPS/GLONASS, satellite phones (Inmarsat/Iridium), GSM base stations

short_role: Truck-mounted jamming station targeting satellite navigation, satellite phones and cellular networks over a wide radius.
characteristics: Two-element system: a reconnaissance/operator vehicle plus a trailer-mounted jamming array
Detects and jams sources across 100–2000 MHz, including GPS/GLONASS, Inmarsat, Iridium and GSM-900/1800
Relatively rare and high-value compared to smaller unit-level jammers, making it a priority target when located
employment_notes: Positioned to deny navigation and satellite comms over a wide area rather than protect one specific unit — its value is denying GPS-guided munitions and satellite-linked drones their positioning and control links across a broad radius, at the cost of being a large, valuable, and therefore high-priority target once its emissions are triangulated.
contrast_vs_traditional: This is the mechanism behind the doctrine finding that EW is the invisible battlefield everything else depends on: a single system like this can degrade GPS-guided precision munitions and satellite-linked drone control over a wide radius, meaning a fight that looks like it's about tanks and artillery is often actually being won or lost in a frequency band nobody on the ground can see.

connections.description: Field maintenance for the truck-mounted jamming station.
